title: Loan is overdue
statement: A loan is overdue at a moment when it has not been returned by then and that moment's date, in the library's time zone, is later than its due date. It is never overdue during its due date, up to and including 23:59 that day in the library's time zone, even when UTC has already moved to the next day; it becomes overdue at 00:00 on the next day. A returned loan is never overdue. A return is late when the loan was overdue at the moment of return.

title: Member has an overdue loan
statement: A member has an overdue loan when any of their loans is overdue (TL-LEND-SP01). Such a member cannot borrow until every overdue loan is returned; there is no grace period and no librarian override.

title: Member is at the loan limit
statement: A member is at the loan limit when they hold 3 active loans, and cannot borrow another. A loan stops counting when it is returned.

title: Tool needs repair
statement: A tool needs repair when its condition is `needs_repair`. Such a tool cannot be lent, and only such a tool can be marked repaired.
